identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of AMG531(Romiplostim) in Patients With Aplastic Anemia
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2/3 Study of AMG531 in Patients With Aplastic Anemia PreviouslyUntreated With Immunosuppressive Therapy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: To evaluate the hematological responses based on the response assessment criteria when AMG531 is subcutaneous (SC)-administered with anti-human thymocyte immunoglobulin (ATG) + ciclosporin A (CsA) therapy for 6 months in patients with aplastic anemia (AA) who were previously untreated with immunosuppressive therapy.

interventions.name: Romiplostim
interventions.description: Romiplostim SC. Initial dose is 10 ug/kg/. Maximum dose is 20 ug/kg. Original duration is 6 months from first administration but if investigator decide that the patient is needed more treatment, they move to extention period and take treatment up to 1 year.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Achievement of complete response (CR) or partial response (PR)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The time to CR or PR
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Each time point evaluated weekly until Week 27
